description: Erection of a single storey rear extension, installation of two flank roof lights with associated internal alternations
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The works to which this consent relates, must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of this consent.
Condition : 2 - All new internal and external works, including works of making good, shall match the original work in both type, colour and dimensions of materials and in detailed execution.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted ( PM01, PM02, PM03 and PM04- received 25/10/18
1375 204 A, unnumbered location plan and design and access statement- received 19/03/20
1375 202 A- received 10/06/20) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 4 - The roof lights shall be 'conservation style', installed to be flush with the existing roof slope.
